liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (2 reviews): Opener has Bruce on keys and accordion throwing licks that Jerry quickly picks up and expands; Shakedown through Train To Cry made a strong opening stretch that the band sustained all night [20][22]
- **Samson and Delilah** (1 review): Reviewer says Samson carried extra significance at the Garden and the band delivered it well [22]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Bruce is especially strong through the He's Gone, Nobody's Fault But Mine, Spoonful sequence [23]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Reviewer calls it their favorite Stella Blue, with Bruce and Jerry nailing it [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-09-22.172750.me88.mc.rogosa.flac2496** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 158 min [1]
- **gd1991-09-22.sbd.serafin.tetzeli.fix-7692.34686.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 149 min [5]
- **gd91-09-22.sbd.fishman.17180.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 4.88/5 by 25 [8]. Said about its sound: Soundboard quality rated A+; Phil comes through clearly and Bruce's piano is high in the mix [24]
- **gd1991-09-22.172749.me88.mc.rogosa.flac1644**: source not stated; 21 songs; 158 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer saw 17 Garden shows and had the most fun at this one [22]
- This show fell in the middle of the band's six-night Boston Garden run on the 1991 fall tour [33]
- Reviewer says this show is better played than the 9-26 show, which got most attention from the run [20]
- Reviewer counts it among very few 1990s shows they wholeheartedly endorse, citing the band's cohesion [23]
- Reviewer calls this run the last great Dead run, with only isolated good moments afterward [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-09-22.172750.me88.mc.rogosa.flac2496**: taped by Dan Rogosa; transferred by Mark Goldey; source: 2x Sennheiser ME 88s (stand, OTS) > TCD-D3 > line out > TCD-D5 (Dolby B) [1]. Also: Third of six Boston Garden recordings Dan made on DAT and cassette; this is the cassette version [1]
- **gd1991-09-22.sbd.serafin.tetzeli.fix-7692.34686.flac16**: transferred by fix of shnid 7692 by Bill Tetzeli; source: Soundboard [5]. Also: Fix of Jay Serafin's soundboard upload; CD 2 to 3 transition made seamless by removing overlapping material; Volume adjusted at splice points, SBEs corrected with shntool, and Drums and Space split into separate tracks [5]
- **gd91-09-22.sbd.fishman.17180.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD>DAT>CD-R>EAC>WAV>ADDAWAV>CDRWAV>SHN (via MKWACT) via J. Fishman [8]
- **gd1991-09-22.172749.me88.mc.rogosa.flac1644**: taped by Dan Rogosa; transferred by Mark Goldey; source: 2x Sennheiser ME 88s (stand, OTS) > TCD-D3 > line out > TCD-D5 (Dolby B) [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead of the Day: [09-22-1991 – Complete Show](https://gratefuldeadoftheday.com/video/09-22-1991-complete-show/) [37]
